items.title: Same LLM, same input tokens, different answers on a MacBook and a Jetson
items.summary: We ran one language model on a MacBook and on a Jetson, with identical weights and inputs. The scores matched; up to 7% of the maths answers did not, and with int8 weights more than half. Why hardware changes answers, how two recent papers turn that into an attack, and what to check before you ship.
